scripts.setup:e2e: bun install --cwd trial --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts && bun run --cwd trial setup:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 bun scripts/test.ts playwright trial/playwright.config.js trial/artifacts
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run complexity && bun run typecheck && bun run test:control && bun run test:trial-control && bun run test:e2e
scripts.check:harness: bun run lint:harness && bun run format:check && bun run complexity:harness && bun run typecheck && bun run test:control
scripts.check:trial: bun run lint:trial && bun run complexity:trial && bun run test:trial-control && bun run test:e2e
